description: Smoke test of the campus-customs-ops MCP server. Each tool was called by Claude Code over the live MCP connection set up in .mcp.json. Each tool output was checked against a read-only query of data/campus_customs_new.db.

tests.prompt: Ticket 101: Tauhid Zaman wants one Classic Bulldog Tee in size S. Do we have one on the shelf?
tests.db_query: SELECT sku, name, size, qty, location FROM inventory WHERE sku='CC-TEE-WHITE' AND size='S'

tests.prompt: Ticket 102: we got an email from Elm City Properties saying rent is due in 2 days. Check it against our lease 1 record. How much is due, and when?
tests.db_query: SELECT id, space_name, landlord, monthly_rent, next_due, notes FROM leases WHERE id=1; SELECT date_today FROM desk

tests.prompt: Ticket 103: the Yale AI Club wants 20 navy hoodies and is asking for a bulk discount. What's our list price and cost on 20, so we know how far we could go?
tests.db_query: SELECT sku, unit_cost, list_price FROM pricing WHERE sku='CC-HOOD-NAVY'
